title: Anthony M NDEs 6819 NDE 6819
content: I've had two NDEs. In 1939, when I was 4 years old, I had an operation to remove my tonsils. During this operation I became aware that I was floating above a table where two doctors, one on either side of the table, were bending over and working on who I believe to be me. Both doctors were wearing voluminous light grey surgical gowns, face masks and hair caps. The table was an off-white colour about 6 feet long, 2 feet wide and with a 3 or 4 inch flange with rounded edges. I was observing them from a height of about 20 feet and at a 45 deg. angle from the nearer edge of the table. The doctors were at the opposite end of the table from where I was watching and because I was small their gowns obscured my body from my sight. From my vantage point above these doctors my whole attention was on them and therefore I did not look around to see what else was in the room but I had the impression that any furniture or other people were some distance away. It was as though some sort of mist or fog had obliterated the surroundings. I did note however that the table had no cloth or other covering on the part that I could see. I watched these doctors for what appeared to be about one minute then the whole scene faded from view. To this day, 76 years later, I can still clearly recall this experience as though it happened yesterday. In December 1999, I was diagnosed with colon cancer, which required surgery to remove two cancerous polyps. I was expected to be leave the hospital after 10. In reality, my recovery lasted 4 weeks. My wife, Betty, was advised one night that I would not survive until the next morning and that if she wanted to be with me when I died, she should come to the hospital as soon as possible. She came in with our neighbour, Kevin, but I was in a coma and did not know that they were there. During that night, I was floating in an area of total blackness and I noticed that I had no body. I felt completely relaxed with no emotion of fear or joy. I was just floating in blackness. After a short while, I became aware of a very bright light in the distance and that I was floating towards it. This light was round. I thought that I was in a tunnel except that I could not discern any roof, walls or floor. Everything was completely black except for the light in the distance. Then I heard a male voice speaking. This voice was absolutely clear and seemed to reverberate as though I were in a sound box. Even though the voice was not speaking to me, I understood what was being said and that the information involved me. This voice was not to my left or right, it was within me. The communication was telepathic. The voice said, 'We do not want him here yet. Send him back.” I immediately did a U-turn by flipping over onto what would have been my back. I went back into the blackness with the light behind me. I couldn't see it any more. I woke up in my bed in the hospital and saw Betty and Kevin in my room. They both appeared quite puzzled because they were expecting me to die, not to wake up and look around. I asked Betty what was the time. She told me that it was 2 o'clock in the morning. I told her to go home and get some sleep. At that time, I was unaware that I was expected to die and was puzzled why they were there at that time of night. From that moment on, I was feeling good and whatever was causing my death completely vanished. I was discharged from hospital 2 days later. To this day, 15 years later, I clearly remember the whole sequence. It was not a dream. Dreams tend to be a bit fuzzy and I cannot remember dreams after more than a few seconds. At first I did not take a lot of notice of this experience. I heard Dr. Eben Alexander, an American neurosurgeon, being interviewed on television after writing a book called “Proof of Heaven” and describing his NDE after recovering from inoperable brain cancer. I realised that I had had a similar experience, although nowhere near as profound as his. I then bought his book and realised that the light at the end of the tunnel that I experienced was actually the gateway into heaven and quite a common occurrence with those who have a near death experience. He got through the gateway and was met by a beautiful girl who showed him around heaven. All of their communication whilst he was being escorted around Heaven was via mental telepathy. Dr. Alexander was the child of two teenagers still at school and he was put up for adoption and therefore did not know his biological parents. His biological parents eventually married and had three daughters, one of whom died when she was a young woman. Dr. Alexander eventually managed to find his biological parents who sent him a photograph of the daughter who died. He then recognised this girl as the one who met him in Heaven. This led me to think that my experience might be more common than I thought so I looked up 'near death experience' on the internet and was amazed to find that thousands of people have documented similar experiences to mine. I started telling people about my experience because I was now more confident that I would not be construed as a nutter. But the usual response I got was, 'That's nice...what are you having for dinner?' So, I then only told people I thought might understand and who may perhaps benefit from my experience.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Illness. Surgery-related Other: I had bowel cancer and a large portion of colon had been removed. I was having a prolonged period of recovery to the extent that one night my wife was advised that I would not survive by the next morning so she came to the hospital to be with me when I d I had just had a bowel resection where a large section of cancerous bowel was removed. I was having a prolonged period of recovery. I was in hospital for one month instead of the expected ten days. My wife was advised one night that I would not see another day, so she came to the hospital to be with me when I died.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Tunnel | Void | Darkness | Unearthly light
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: No I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.At what time during the experience were: I was at the same level of alertness during the whole experience, which was very short.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: I was in total blackness and the only thing I could see was the light in the distance. I would describe my vision as being normal.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: The sound of the voice was utterly clear and far better than my normal hearing.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes I was in a place of total blackness with a round light in the distance, which I was traveling toward. It gave the impression that I was in a tunnel.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes The light at the end of the tunnel was very bright. Much brighter than daylight.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes I still was very interested in the experience of others and purchased a few books as well as exploring the internet and what I found was the almost universal concept of the importance of love amongst those who had had near death experiences. God put us on this earth to love Him but He had to give us free will so that we could choose to love Him. If we were made to love Him, loving Him would be meaningless. If we love Him because we want to due to our gift of free will, this love is meaningful. As an example is the relationship of husbands and wives. The best feeling on this earth is to love someone because you want to and to have that love returned because that person wants to love you. This is only possible because we have been made so that our souls have free will. It is exactly the same with God. He loves us but He wants to be loved in return. Now how do you love God? It is so simple. By loving one another. This does not mean hugging strangers on street corners; it means that you don't do or say anything to hurt anyone. We must have no feeling of anger, hatred, revenge or jealousy towards anyone and if you come across anyone in distress, and you can help them, then you help.
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes The voice told me that they did not want me there yet. The ‘yet’ indicates to me that I will be going to heaven and that I must not do anything to make them change their mind.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I heard a voice I could not identify A voice said to me with utmost clarity, ‘we do not want him here yet. Send him back.’
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: experience? God definitely exists Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.Do you believe in an afterlife after you: An afterlife definitely exists Yes The voice said "We do not want him here yet" so I have taken the "here" is an afterlife in heaven.
elements.Were you fearful living your life prior: Moderately fearful in living my earthly life
elements.Were you fearful living your life after: Not fearful in living my earthly life
elements.What life changes occurred in your life: Moderate changes in my life I am much more aware of my responsibility to love my neighbor.
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes Yes I am particularly careful about anything I say or do which may have a detrimental effect on others.
elements.After the NDE: tionships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes Yes I am particularly careful about anything I say or do which may have a detrimental effect on others. After the NDE
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience I remember the experience as clearly today as I did 14 years ago so it was not a dream.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes I have shared this experience with others some years after. The usual response is, ‘that's nice. What are you having for dinner?’ So I now only share if I think that person may benefit from my experience.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real I was not expected to live at the time of my experience. The cause of my imminent death just vanished, so I know that my life was prolonged so that I could perform the tasks I was sent back to do.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real I am not aware of whether I have performed the tasks I was sent back for and am now examining everything I do to check whether any action I take could be this task or tasks.
